description:
React developer delivering high-value experiences across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, used by millions of users daily. Responsible for:
* technically leading feature crews and acting as a link between business side and multiple engineering teams
* designing and implementing products (e.g. [People App](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/manage-your-contacts-with-the-people-app-in-teams-cfea34b9-ac23-4cff-b3d1-c97bb2b1e751)) with strong focus on accessibility and maintainability
* Building and enhancing testing and dependency management tooling (open source and internal) across large monorepositories, benefiting all developers
* Onboarding new team members, conducting knowledge-sharing sessions, and mentoring multiple developers

Working as Java developer on maintaining and improving one of the top European logistics SaaS platforms. Projects I took part in included:
* Implementation of refined and redesigned UI for application main components
* Exhaustive improvement and refactoring of aliasing mechanism for tailored user experience
* Self-directed work improvements:
  * unification and enhancement of local deployment tools
   * integration of code review platform with our workflow
   * introduction and application of User Story Mapping and Pair Programming in the team
Helping other students prepare for the exams
